SPECIFICATION FOR 
CUTTER SUCTION DREDGE COMPONENTS 

PART 3 LADDER

1. Scope — Prescribes the requirements of the ladder used as a component in cutter suction dredgers. 

2. Requirements 

2.1 Design — Ladder shall be designed to carry the suction pipe, lubricating lines and most usually 
the cutter motor and as reduction gear in addition to the cutter. On small dredges the ladder may be 
mounted directly on hull whereas provision of well shall be made in case of mounting the ladder on 
large dredger. 



2.-2 Dimensions 
required. 



The length of the ladder shall be around 1*5 times the maximum dredging depth 



2.3 Construction-- The ladder shall be built with deep web beams, girders, stiffeners, bulkheads and 
large trunnion housings made of steel conforming to IS : 226-1975 ' Structural steel ( standard quality) 
( fifth revision ) '. The construction shall be welded. 



EXPLANATORYNOTE 

This standard has been formulated with the objective of helping in proper design and use of 
appropriate material in the construction of dredge ladder. 



Adopted 31 March 1984
